entries.name: Claude Code
entries.what: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal and edits, runs, and reviews code.

entries.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
entries.what: OpenAI's open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal (also ships as a desktop app).

entries.name: Cursor
entries.what: AI code editor with a built-in agent, plus the Cursor CLI for running the agent in the terminal.

entries.name: Gemini CLI
entries.what: Google's open-source terminal coding agent for Gemini models (deprecated for personal accounts in June 2026 in favor of Antigravity CLI).

entries.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
entries.what: GitHub Copilot's coding agent in the terminal, invoked as copilot.

entries.name: Windsurf (Devin Desktop)
entries.what: Cognition's AI code editor, rebranded from Windsurf to Devin Desktop.

entries.name: Aider
entries.what: AI pair programming in the terminal that edits code in your local git repo.

entries.name: Zed
entries.what: High-performance code editor with a built-in AI agent panel and support for external agents.

entries.name: Cline
entries.what: Autonomous coding agent available as a VS Code extension, CLI, and desktop app.

entries.name: OpenCode
entries.what: Open-source coding agent for the terminal, with a desktop app.

entries.name: Amp
entries.what: Sourcegraph's frontier coding agent available via CLI, web, and native apps.

entries.name: goose
entries.what: Open-source, extensible AI agent (desktop app and CLI) with MCP extensions, now under the Agentic AI Foundation.

entries.name: Kiro
entries.what: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE and terminal CLI.

entries.name: Continue
entries.what: Open-source AI coding assistant (VS Code/JetBrains extension and cn CLI); repo is now read-only after its final 2.0.0 release.

entries.name: Obsidian
entries.what: Local-first Markdown note-taking app with linked notes and plugins.

entries.name: Notion
entries.what: All-in-one workspace for docs, wikis, and project tracking.

entries.name: Linear
entries.what: Issue tracking and project management app for software teams.

entries.name: Raycast
entries.what: Extensible macOS launcher with commands, extensions, and AI.

entries.name: Warp
entries.what: Modern terminal with built-in AI agents.

entries.name: Visual Studio Code
entries.what: Microsoft's extensible code editor.

entries.name: Ghostty
entries.what: Fast, native, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator.

entries.name: Figma
entries.what: Collaborative interface design and prototyping tool.

entries.name: Linear MCP
entries.what: Lets agents find, create, and update Linear issues, projects, and comments.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp

entries.name: Notion MCP
entries.what: Lets agents search, read, and edit pages and databases in your Notion workspace.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp

entries.name: GitHub MCP
entries.what: Lets agents work with GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, and Actions through GitHub's official server.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GITHUB_PAT"

entries.name: Figma MCP
entries.what: Gives agents design context from Figma files and lets them generate code from or write to the canvas.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp

entries.name: Sentry MCP
entries.what: Lets agents query Sentry issues, errors, and traces to debug production problems.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp

entries.name: Supabase MCP
entries.what: Lets agents manage Supabase projects: run SQL, inspect schemas, deploy Edge Functions, and read logs.

install.command: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http supabase "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp"

entries.name: Neon MCP
entries.what: Lets agents manage Neon Postgres projects, branches, and run queries and schema changes.

entries.name: Stripe MCP
entries.what: Lets agents call the Stripe API and search Stripe documentation.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http stripe https://mcp.stripe.com/

entries.name: Vercel MCP
entries.what: Lets agents search Vercel docs and manage projects, deployments, and logs.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http vercel https://mcp.vercel.com

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.what: Lets agents drive a real browser via Playwright using accessibility snapshots.

entries.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
entries.what: Lets agents control and inspect a live Chrome browser for debugging and performance analysis.

install.command: claude mcp add chrome-devtools --scope user npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

entries.name: Context7
entries.what: Feeds agents up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples.

entries.name: Exa MCP
entries.what: Gives agents web search, code search, and page fetching via Exa.

entries.name: Tavily MCP
entries.what: Gives agents real-time web search and page extraction via Tavily.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http tavily https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp

entries.name: Slack MCP
entries.what: Lets agents search, read, and send Slack messages, threads, and canvases.

entries.name: Atlassian Rovo MCP
entries.what: Lets agents read and update Jira issues and Confluence pages.

install.command: claude mcp add --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp

entries.name: Filesystem MCP
entries.what: Gives agents read/write access to files inside directories you allow.

entries.name: Memory MCP
entries.what: Gives agents persistent memory via a local knowledge graph.

entries.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
entries.what: Gives agents a tool for structured step-by-step reasoning and revising thoughts.

entries.name: Obsidian MCP (community)
entries.what: Lets agents read and edit notes in an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API plugin.

entries.name: PostHog MCP
entries.what: Lets agents query PostHog analytics, manage feature flags, and investigate errors.

entries.name: Cloudflare MCP
entries.what: Gives agents broad access to Cloudflare's APIs through Cloudflare's Code Mode server.

entries.name: Cloudflare Docs MCP
entries.what: Gives agents up-to-date Cloudflare documentation.

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers Bindings MCP
entries.what: Lets agents build Workers apps using storage, AI, and compute bindings.

entries.name: Firecrawl MCP
entries.what: Lets agents scrape, crawl, and search the web as clean markdown.

entries.name: Browserbase MCP
entries.what: Lets agents control cloud browsers via Browserbase and Stagehand.

entries.name: Asana MCP
entries.what: Lets agents read and manage Asana tasks, projects, and goals.

entries.name: Hugging Face MCP
entries.what: Lets agents search Hugging Face models, datasets, papers, and Spaces.

install.command: claude mcp add hf-mcp-server -t http https://huggingface.co/mcp?login

entries.name: Netlify MCP
entries.what: Lets agents create, build, deploy, and manage Netlify projects.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.what: Skills framework that makes coding agents brainstorm, write plans, do test-driven development, debug systematically and review code before finishing.

entries.name: gstack
entries.what: Garry Tan's suite of Claude Code skills that act as a virtual engineering team: product and eng plan reviews, design review, QA with a headless browser, and ship/deploy workflows.

entries.name: Caveman
entries.what: Makes the agent answer in terse caveman-style speech to cut output tokens while keeping technical accuracy, plus compressed commits and reviews.

entries.name: Vercel Plugin
entries.what: Vercel ecosystem plugin with skills for Next.js, AI SDK, functions, storage, env vars and deployments, plus specialist agents and deploy commands.

entries.name: Stripe Plugin
entries.what: Stripe's official Claude Code plugin with Stripe best-practice skills, error explanations, test card lookup and the Stripe MCP server.

entries.name: Context7 Plugin
entries.what: Connects Claude Code to Upstash Context7's hosted MCP server for up-to-date library documentation lookup.

entries.name: Frontend Design
entries.what: Skill that helps Claude build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic AI aesthetics.

entries.name: Code Review
entries.what: Automated pull request review using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring to filter false positives.

entries.name: PR Review Toolkit
entries.what: Set of PR review agents for comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality and simplification.

entries.name: Commit Commands
entries.what: Slash commands for git workflows: commit, push and open a pull request.

entries.name: Feature Dev
entries.what: Guided feature development workflow with agents for codebase exploration, architecture design and quality review.

entries.name: Code Simplifier
entries.what: Agent that refines recently modified code for clarity, consistency and maintainability without changing behavior.

entries.name: Security Guidance
entries.what: Security review for Claude-written code: pattern warnings on edits and LLM-powered diff review.

entries.name: Hookify
entries.what: Creates custom Claude Code hooks from simple rules to block unwanted behaviors.

entries.name: Ralph Loop
entries.what: Runs Claude on the same task repeatedly in a self-referential loop until it is done (the Ralph Wiggum technique).

entries.name: Plugin Dev
entries.what: Toolkit with skills for building Claude Code plugins: hooks, MCP integration, commands and agents.

entries.name: Skill Creator Plugin
entries.what: Create new skills, improve existing ones and measure skill performance.

entries.name: Anthropic Agent Skills
entries.what: Anthropic's official skills repo, installable as document-skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) and example-skills plugin packs.

install.command: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills && /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills && /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills

entries.name: PDF Skill
entries.what: Reads, extracts, fills forms in, merges and creates PDF files.

entries.name: DOCX Skill
entries.what: Creates and edits Word documents, including tracked changes and comments.

entries.name: XLSX Skill
entries.what: Creates and edits Excel spreadsheets with formulas, formatting and data analysis.

entries.name: PPTX Skill
entries.what: Creates and edits PowerPoint presentations.

entries.name: Skill Creator
entries.what: Guides creating and improving Agent Skills.

entries.name: MCP Builder
entries.what: Guides building high-quality MCP servers.

entries.name: Webapp Testing
entries.what: Tests local web apps with Playwright: verifies UI, captures screenshots and reads browser logs.

entries.name: Playwright Skill
entries.what: Lets Claude write and run custom Playwright browser automation scripts, with a visible browser by default.

entries.name: Vercel CLI
entries.what: Deploy and manage Vercel projects, env vars, domains and logs from the terminal.

entries.name: Supabase CLI
entries.what: Run Supabase locally and manage database migrations, functions and projects.

entries.name: Wrangler (Cloudflare)
entries.what: Develop, test and deploy Cloudflare Workers and manage Cloudflare resources.

entries.name: flyctl (Fly.io)
entries.what: Launch, deploy and manage apps on Fly.io from the terminal.

entries.name: Railway CLI
entries.what: Deploy and manage Railway projects, services and environment variables.

entries.name: Netlify CLI
entries.what: Run local dev, build and deploy sites to Netlify from the terminal.

entries.name: Playwright Test
entries.what: End-to-end browser testing framework for web apps across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

entries.name: Vitest

entries.name: Jest
entries.what: JavaScript testing framework for unit and snapshot tests.

entries.name: Docker
entries.what: Build, run and ship applications in containers.

entries.name: uv
entries.what: Extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.

entries.name: Bun
entries.what: All-in-one JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner and package manager.

entries.name: pnpm
entries.what: Fast, disk-space-efficient JavaScript package manager.

entries.name: Ollama
entries.what: Download and run large language models locally.

entries.name: Stripe CLI
entries.what: Build, test and manage Stripe integrations, including forwarding webhooks locally.

entries.name: Neon CLI
entries.what: Manage Neon serverless Postgres projects, branches and databases from the terminal.

entries.name: Turso CLI
entries.what: Manage Turso (libSQL) cloud databases, groups and auth tokens.

entries.name: ESLint

entries.name: Prettier

entries.name: Biome
entries.what: Fast formatter and linter for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON and CSS.

entries.name: Ruff
entries.what: Extremely fast Python linter and code formatter written in Rust.

entries.name: pytest
entries.what: Python testing framework for writing small to complex functional tests.

entries.name: Sentry CLI
entries.what: Upload source maps and debug files, manage releases and send events to Sentry.

entries.name: lazygit
entries.what: Simple terminal UI for git commands.
